data.text: A sea fantasista known by the nickname "Seven Stars". Its delicate appearance comes with an explosion of flavor you’d never imagine—best paired with the kabayaki sauce. Tonight, savor the good fortune of having reeled in this star!

Driven by a fierce desire to climb the ranks, this ambitious fellow's name changes as it grows in size. Once this mighty unit of a fish is cooked, its fragrant fat strikes straight at your appetite, gripping your stomach, and never letting go.

With its beautiful and graceful form, it is known as the "Lady of the Shore". Yet the sharp pull that belies that elegance awakens the hunter’s instinct in anglers. Make it into tempura and its crisp, fluffy flesh will melt in your mouth. Exquisito!

The ocean’s trickster. Favorite pastime? Stealing bait from anglers. But surely that frustration will vanish the moment you taste its sashimi, paired with some liver in soy sauce! A ruthless battle of wits between the bait-stealing trickster and angler awaits!

Its plump appearance will soothe your soul, yet in the hands of an amateur with a kitchen knife, it could well become someone’s final supper! A forbidden delicacy prepared only by top tier master chefs.
A sea-boxer whose shock waves can shatter shells. But the rich flavor flowing from those mighty arms shows its true worth when boiled in salt! A supreme delicacy that makes gourmets moan in delight.

A star-shaped creature of the sea. There’s even certain kinds prized as snacks, but known only to deep-sea connoisseurs. Beyond its appearance lies a coastal depth of flavor that only true gourmets will ever taste!

An entertainer that leaps from the sea and hops across the land. Its cute looks makes your heart go all doki-doki, but in some regions, it shines as a hidden gourmet ingredient! It tastes fantastic in stews, as deep-fried dishes, and in hot pots!

Its graceful dance makes it the true idol of the aquarium. Referred to as a kind of octopus in other languages, it is in reality a well-known jellyfish (no takodachis were harmed when writing this piece). You might imagine the perfect bite paired with ponzu, but this one is strictly for display only!

The belle of the aquarium, undergoing a beautiful transformation from female to male. Its skill at baiting anglers’ bait is first-rate, yet once simmered or turned into tempura, its refined sweetness makes tongues do a salsa dance. A hidden main character worth the catch!

As another one of its names means "the spring-heralding fish", this fish carries the season with it. Its fluffy flesh soaks up the simmering juices, evoking the coming of spring, and your chopsticks will never stop. Its extreme nearsightedness is just a kawaii key-point.

This fishy here loves fluttering through coral flower fields like an actual butterfly of the sea. Once cherished as food in some regions, it has now secured an unshakable position as an ornamental fish.

Often mistaken for a member of the sea bream family, it actually belongs to the Alfonsino family. Before you lose yourself in those golden eyes, have a serving simmered in sauce. Its plump flesh should melt in your mouth!

The “Scarlet Anthias” that dyes coral reefs crimson. Its dazzling colors show their true worth on their own little stage—an aquarium tank. A tropical idol that doesn't fill your stomach, but the angler’s heart with vivid joy!
Also known as the “Jewel of the Sea,” its true form is a shape-shifting mollusk. Its mysterious horns and colorful body look just like something out of an isekai anime!

Striding along the seabed and sounding its swim bladder, it is the ultimate oddity of the deep. Beloved by feudal lords of the past, its true essence lies in sashimi! The more you chew, the more the flavor overflows!
The undeniable superstar of the fish world! From the springy texture of its sashimi to the rich aroma of sea bream rice, every preparation delivers a leading-role level of flavor.

A high-grade fish saddled with the bittersweet name “old man” in Japanese... Yet in dish after dish it shows such depth of flavor. Didn’t they say something along the lines of no country for old men? Yet here we are. Applause for the prowess that blows away prejudice!
The way it adorably peeks its head out from the sand grabs fans’ hearts and never lets go. Its gently swaying, cute little dance fills anglers’ hearts more than any high-class fish ever could.

An astonishing fashionista that trades its spiral pattern, used to confuse predators, for bold stripes as it grows. It’s the ultimate visual star, satisfying the aesthetic sense of all who look upon it.
Its vivid orange-is-the-new-black pattern is pure hype. Its face is cute, but its hot-blooded temperament makes territorial skirmishes a casual breakfast.

It bid farewell to its dark past of being dismissed as a subspecies and finally opened its eyes as a new species in 2017! Depending on the region, this late-blooming dark horse is prized for fried and simmered dishes!
The ocean’s king of longevity! Grill it boldly with plenty of garlic, and its rich and plumpy flesh will seize the hearts of even kings!

With an adorably charming form, it’s a star attraction that has earned an unshakable place in aquariums. In some regions, it’s also a long-familiar ingredient, making it a twice-delightful miracle of the deep seas.

A dream fish that you’d love to catch at least once. It shuffles along the seafloor, flares its pectoral fins to startle others, and acts almost like a comedian. The way it swims as if beating great wings with its large fins is incredibly cool.

A dream fish that you’d love to catch at least once. Its brain is highly developed, making itself Koyori’s perfect match. When you see it gracefully cruising and are caught in the gaze of its intelligence-filled eyes, you’ll be left speechless.

A gorgeous shrimp with vivid colors, admired by anglers everywhere. Its appearance exudes a glamorous, high-class air, but when startled, it curls up and shoots backward, trying to disappear in shame.

This heck of a unit was once endorsed by a shogun’s household! But to be honest, it’s a down-to-earth species that can survive in harsh environments. If eaten in winter season, you’ll have a luxury dish that even high-class cuisine can’t compete with!
It’s so cool it bears the name Autumn’s Sword. A migratory fish that usually ends up sizzling and popping on charcoal grills during the arrival of fall.

The “Spring Herald fish”. Its golden shimmer is seen as a lucky sign, filling you with the sense of spring’s breath. Place its sweet simmered fillet atop soba, and a joy wells up in you for having made it through the long winter!

A blue miracle found along the coastline. Not related to any archive of the sort. Whether in classic dishes or dressed in vinegar miso, its concentrated scent of the seashore pierces your nose and captivates your stomach!

The entertainer of the sea! Boiling it bright red is great, but hotpot is just as irresistible! Savor every last drop of the rich flavor that seeps into the rice porridge at the end! Some say a scary princess lives inside its shell.
A lucky fellow regarded as a symbol of longevity and warding off evil. Spice it up as chili shrimp or turn it into tempura to unlock its full potential!

The glutton of the sea, clad in a black, spiky suit of armor, sometimes devouring all the seaweed in its path, and sometimes a bit too edgy. Place it on white rice and the briny aroma and overflowing rich sweetness will surely embrace your stomach!
Its grotesque appearance and deadly poisonous spines are intimidating, but beneath them lies one of the finest high-class fish with pure white flesh. If you deep-fry it, you can even munch its bones!

A born hunter that buries itself in the sand and takes down its prey with a single strike. If you slice the taut hunter’s body thin and enjoy it with some grated spicy daikon, your taste buds are sure to be blown away!

It hides in the sand, patiently waiting for its chance. That persistence is what nurtures its tightly packed, supreme flesh. Cloaked in a rich simmering broth, its meat makes it impossible to put your chopsticks down!

A living crystal that gleams in the frozen seas. Its clear, colorless blood, stirs the intellectual curiosity of all who see it. Catch one just once, and you’re sure to become a captive of its mysteries!
Also known as the Flower Fish. If you eat it with grated daikon, you won’t be able to stop eating rice! Truly a heavyweight of the north, and an absolute unit of a staple on Japanese izakaya!

On the outside, it looks like a sharp Japanese sword, but inside, it’s a true prince of fatty white meat! Grilling it to a crisp is great, but if you give it a western twist with butter, it’ll brilliantly slash across your palate!
A living piece of glass art that simply lets itself drift with the ocean’s currents. Under the aquarium lights, its body transmits the glow as it gently sways, bringing deep comfort to your heart.
Slice it thick and grill it like a steak with butter, and the overflowing fat is sure to cut clean through your palate like a single, decisive stroke! Truly a feast fit for kings!
A drab and bulky deep-sea creature, known for its fat. Put just one piece in your mouth and its ultra-rich fat will explode across your palate. Just be careful not to overeat!
One of the top crowd-pleasers, even in aquariums. The male nurtures the life entrusted to him by the female, pouring his love into it. A long-standing super dad of the sea!

A speed-freak with a massive body that can exceed 100 km/h! If it crashes into you, you won’t stand a chance, but from fatty cuts to the collar, you can savor it without wasting a single part. Truly the pinnacle of gourmet delight!
A flat, mysterious being that lives in the deepest, darkest abyss. Because it makes its home in the deep sea, it’s weak to light and has an extremely delicate body.

A living fossil that has risen from the deep sea, transcending 500 million years. Faced with these beings that have survived for eons, you’re made painfully aware of how quickly human history passed by in comparison.

If you dare trespass on its turf, this sea gangster will attack you, even if you’re human. It’s a real pain to catch and prepare, but once you fry it, you’re in for a gourmet experience with this truly high-grade fish!
Its enormous body can reach up to 8 meters long, boasting a beauty on the level of an urban legend! Try to spot this rare character that emerges from the stillness of the deep seas!
A myth made reality: an 18 meter giant. Its lifespan however, is merele a fleeting 3 years. If you’re lucky enough to find one, thank him for his hard work!

Its name, along with its massive body that can reach up to 7 meters, and its large mouth, only heighten the fear it inspires. Since its ecology is still shrouded in mystery, if you ever reel one in, make sure to report it to the proper authorities!
The ice fairy of the seas: a beautiful creature admired among fishermen. But be careful, as this fairy can mercilessly jab you with its tentacles!

A fish many dream of catching someday, known for its lips and adorable patterns. The part on its head that looks like a pirate hat sometimes sparks arguments among fishermen over whether or not it detaches.

A dream fish that every angler hopes to catch one day. It perfectly embodies "chaos", featuring what look like actual mouse ears despite being a fish, and possessing a body shaped like a sillago, even though it doesn't belong to that family at all.

Also known as the "Wolf of the Sea". This fish will shock you with the strength of its pull if you carelessly treat it like an ordinary mackerel. The taste of victory earned after such a fierce battle is a supreme, fatty richness that rivals the finest tuna!
This fish is pure speed incarnate. Its body, forged in rough seas, shows you its true form when grilled. Together with its fragrant aroma, even you can go max speed!!!
The fish who overcame everything on its way to success. This all-purpose fish can be cooked in all different kinds of dishes in any way imaginable.
From 0 to 40km/h in a flash. This squid uses an organ called funnel to jet itself at high speeds in an instant. Today too, it is racing against fisherman who wants to eat it as sashimi.

A hunter who rules the southern seas. It’s reputed to be delicious, but in some regions they are poisonous. Perhaps this very danger is what makes it a forbidden delicacy that only the brave can reach?!
The thousand needles warrior who manages to drive off any foe it faces...even though it only has around 400. If you ever see one, don’t be a spoilsport, and just cheer it on with all your heart!

A tropical tapestry marked by its beautiful horns. It is said to be a luck-bringing fish that rapidly boosts your fortune, and is extremely popular as an ornamental fish to boot! Keep one, and your life will surely overflow with something better than hopium!

It captivates all who gaze upon it with a visual like a flower, blooming in the sea. Hidden within those beautiful fins, you will find venomous spines, ready to bestow a deadly embrace on anyone who comes too close.
Though it has a very unique silhouette, inside its shell you can find a luxurious crustacean on par with a lobster! It can be enjoyed as sashimi or in a soup. Welcome to the new fine dining!
This protean fashionista shifts from black to white when it gets excited. It also sports a pink-ish tail that gives a cute accent!
When this high grade fish is hauled up from the deep sea, its eyes pop out! If you can’t catch one, just head straight to an upscale restaurant!
The power of this absolute unit of a fish can rival even the hottest shonen anime battle scenes. It has many regional names, but it is still a top-class delicatessen!
Beloved by Edo citizens and gym goers alike, this fish is high in protein, low in fat, rich in iron, and works wonders with your everyday fatigue. Sear it lightly before you take a big bite!

A fish hauled from the rough winter seas. Dip it briefly into piping hot broth or enjoy it with ponzu. The sheer impact of its deliciousness is truly off the charts! It may also bless you with good fortune to boot!

Its long snout makes it look like a jazz musician with a trumpet. Whether it’s camouflaging itself or slipping in among larger fish, it spends every day enjoying improvisation like in a jazz bar play session.

A gigantic silhouette lurking deep within dark rocky reefs. With such a small distribution, it’s known as a luxurious phantom fish. Its white meat, surpassing even the puffer fish, is packed with collagen!
The one and only "Janitor of the Deep Seas". There are records of it fasting for nearly five years, living a low-energy lifestyle.

Very lil’ creatures that cling to larger fish and live off their leftovers. Whether eaten as sashimi or grilled, its rich fat and exquisite flavor overflows, making it a prized catch among certain anglers!

They are divided into fish and reptiles, with some of the fish being edible. Certain reptiles are also eaten in some regions as high-class medicinal cuisine, but they are poisonous, so caution is required! Truly a forbidden fruit lurking beneath the sea!
A 2 meter giant that boasts speeds of 50km/h. A fast underwater rocket that is also poisonous. Should you encounter one in the sea, it’ll probably just stare at you with a cold, steely gaze...

A ray that flutters its giant mantle as it glides freely through the ocean. In some regions, it’s also eaten, with its wing-like fins especially favored. When deep-fried, they’re said to have a texture close to chicken.

Its overly unique hammer-shaped head tends to be seen as cute, but is really a highly advanced piece of tech. It can sense heartbeats and even electric currents! It is usually eaten fried, or even made into fishcakes in several places!

The largest fish ever recorded in history, reaching a maximum length of 20 meters. Its defining trait is a one of a kind jinbei-style pattern that differs from individual to individual. It also leads schools of small fish as it swims with majestic ease, granting it the nickname of "King of the Sea".
A dream fish you’ll want to catch someday. It looks similar to the Rhinecanthus tigerish, but it’s even more mischievous. A lovable little brat that keeps pestering you with cheeky charm.

Admired by all the local fishermen, this crab sports some sweet shuriken-like markings. It is called the "Gorilla of the Sea", and its grip strength can surpass the 50kg mark, just like another gorilla on this island.

Admired by all the local fishermen, its most distinctive feature is its clown-like hat. Usually it hides by mimicking the sandy seabed or rocks, but every so often it suddenly pops its face out like its joking around.
